title: A Deep Cascade of Convolutional Neural Networks for Dynamic MR Image Reconstruction
layout_note: One-row cascade Input → CNN_1 → DC → CNN_2 → DC → … → CNN_nc → DC → Output in the middle; a 'k-space samples' box at the lower left sends one horizontal line under the row with vertical taps up into every DC. Above the row, two detail panels (the CNN body on the left, the DC layer on the right) are tied by dashed zoom lines to CNN_1 and to the last DC.
grouping: Tint matching ties boxes to panels: CNN boxes and the CNN detail panel share a very faint lavender fill, DC boxes and the DC panel a very faint green; the detail panels are square-cornered with a heavier dark outline.
shapes_depth: Flat square-cornered boxes with thin black outlines, all text serif math (C_1, C_rec, F, f_dc, F^H, x_u, x_rec, y). An optional layer (DS, data sharing) is drawn as a dashed italic box; the residual connection is a line over the top of the CNN panel to a circled plus. No images.
proposed_highlight: Nothing is coloured as new; the repeated alternation of CNN and DC blocks is the message, and the two expanded panels show what one CNN and one DC hold.
lesson: The measured k-space samples run as one horizontal bus beneath the cascade with a vertical tap into every DC block, so the repeated data consistency reads as one shared input rather than many separate arrows.
notes: venue IEEE TMI from the PDF header ('Accepted for IEEE Transactions on Medical Imaging') and the arXiv comment; year = arXiv preprint year (1704.02422). Typeset in LaTeX (TikZ-like), serif throughout.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)

taxonomy.task: dynamic/static MRI reconstruction from undersampled k-space
taxonomy.note: paradigm = Deep Cascade of CNNs (Schlemper et al.), the paper itself

core.what: one horizontal chain unrolls the cascade as alternating CNN_i and DC boxes (Input -> CNN1 -> DC -> CNN2 -> DC -> ... -> CNN_nc -> DC -> Output), each DC fed from below by a shared 'k-space samples' bus

relations.form: two full CNN/DC pairs then an ellipsis and a final pair along one row, the repeated unit drawn with the same box shapes and tints each time

two detail panels above the chain, tied by dashed trapezoid lines and matching tint: the CNN block (dashed optional DS, conv layers C1..C_rec, residual ⊕) at top-left from CNN1, the DC block (F -> f_dc -> F^H with y from below) at top-right from the last DC
a 'k-space samples' box at bottom-left feeds a bus line under the chain that rises vertically into every DC box

channels.colour: faint lavender = CNN block (chain boxes and its detail panel), faint green = data-consistency block (chain boxes and its detail panel); white = input/output
channels.shape: all plain rectangles; ⊕ circle for the residual add
channels.line: solid arrows = data flow; dashed box = optional layer (DS); dashed straight lines = zoom callouts — dashes carry two meanings

quality.strengths: The cascade is drawn as an unrolled row with both repeated blocks opened once above it and tied by tint and callout lines, so the overview stays compact and each unit is taught once; the measured k-space enters each DC from one bus rather than separate wires; all lines are straight and orthogonal.
quality.weaknesses: Nothing is drawn as data: images and k-space are only symbols (x_u, x_cnn, y), so the reader never sees an undersampled image or a mask; dashes mean both 'optional layer' and 'zoom callout'; the CNN detail's output (x_cnn1) and the DC detail's input (x_cnn_i) use different indices.

insights.structure: One horizontal chain at the bottom (Input -> CNN1 -> DC -> CNN2 -> DC -> ... -> CNN_nc -> DC -> Output) with two square-cornered detail panels above it: a CNN-block detail at top-left and a data-consistency detail at top-right.
insights.data: Data are only math labels: x_u, x_cnn, x_rec, y for measured k-space; the CNN detail shows an optional dashed DS box, conv layers C1 ... C_rec and a residual ⊕; the DC detail shows F -> f_dc -> F^H with y entering from below.
insights.emphasis: Tint matching ties boxes to details: CNN boxes and the CNN panel share a faint lavender fill, DC boxes and the DC panel a faint green; detail panels have a heavier outline than the chain.
insights.flow: Strictly left to right along the chain; a 'k-space samples' bus line runs under the chain and rises into every DC box; dashed trapezoid lines open from CNN1 and the last DC up to their detail panels.
insights.avoid: No images of the undersampled input or reconstruction appear, so the k-space-vs-image alternation is only in symbols; the CNN zoom lines are long and shallow so the link from CNN1 to its panel is easy to miss.

arrangement.units: the cascade chain of plain rectangles at bottom; two zoom-detail units above it, framed by heavy-outlined tinted rectangles
arrangement.inputs_as: plain text boxes 'Input' at the chain start and 'k-space samples' at bottom-left feeding a bus line
arrangement.shared: one k-space bus feeds every DC block; CNN and DC blocks are repeated copies detailed once
